name: Audit: PageSpeed (mobile)
description: Runs PageSpeed Insights (Google fetches the site) for Google-sourced prospects with a website and no ok audit in 30 days. Capped by batchSize and dailyLimit; stores scores, metrics and normalized findings.

parameters.query:
SELECT id AS prospect_id, name, regexp_replace(website_url, '[?#].*$', '') AS url
FROM prospects p
WHERE website_url IS NOT NULL AND website_url <> ''
  AND source = 'google_places'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit_runs a WHERE a.prospect_id = p.id AND a.kind = 'pagespeed' AND a.status = 'ok' AND a.ran_at > now() - interval '30 days')
ORDER BY id
LIMIT GREATEST(0, LEAST($1::int, $2::int - (SELECT count(*) FROM audit_runs WHERE kind = 'pagespeed' AND ran_at >= date_trunc('day', now()))::int))

WITH run AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_runs (prospect_id, kind, strategy, url, status, scores, metrics, error, n8n_execution_id)
  VALUES ($1::bigint, 'pagespeed', $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb, $6::jsonb, $7, $8)
  RETURNING id
), f AS (
  INSERT INTO findings (audit_run_id, check_name, severity, evidence, business_impact_text)
  SELECT run.id, x.check_name, x.severity, x.evidence, x.business_impact_text
  FROM run, jsonb_to_recordset($9::jsonb) AS x(check_name text, severity text, evidence text, business_impact_text text)
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT run.id AS audit_run_id, $1::bigint AS prospect_id, $4 AS status, (SELECT count(*) FROM f)::int AS findings FROM run
